title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Wednesday, 18 November 2026
description: Australia moves to legislate mandatory AI safety obligations and a new regulator, the extended childcare wage subsidy keeps educator pay rises in place, Queensland widens its flood recovery grants, and the Gold Coast scrambles to fill a gap left by the cancelled World Supercross round. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
